challenges.objection: global neuromodulator mistaken for generic controller
challenges.source_reaudit_result: Global RPE/neuromodulatory broadcast gates plasticity at tagged synapses; source does not make it a general-purpose executive.

challenges.objection: synaptic tag/trace mistaken for online coordinator
challenges.source_reaudit_result: Tags/traces are source-defined eligibility/credit state and plasticity machinery.
Source explicitly maps tag decay to SARSA(lambda) eligibility traces under parameter correspondence.
Source does not specify unique mechanism; intracellular, local recurrent and larger-network options remain open.
Architecture is biologically plausible simulation, not direct in-vivo causal validation.
